title: PO-PDDL: Learning Symbolic POMDPs from Visual Demonstrations for Robot Planning Under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2606.15654v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Real-world robot task planning must operate under both stochastic action execution and partial observability, yet constructing Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) models for real robotics domains remains difficult and labor-intensive. We introduce PO-PDDL, a symbolic formulation of POMDPs that preserves the relational structure and LLM-friendly syntax of the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), while explicitly modeling partial observability, stochasticity, and beliefs. Building on this formulation, we propose a demonstration-driven pipeline for learning PO-PDDL models. The proposed method reconstructs latent symbolic state trajectories from real-robot execution videos, identifies partial observability via inconsistencies between inferred states and visual observations, and learns stochastic transition and observation models accordingly. translated_title: PO-PDDL：从视觉演示中学习符号化POMDP，用于机器人不确定环境下的规划
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的机器人任务规划必须在随机动作执行和部分可观测性下运行，然而为真实机器人领域构建部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）模型仍然困难且劳动密集。我们引入了PO-PDDL，这是一种POMDP的符号化表述，它保留了规划领域定义语言（PDDL）的关系结构和适合大型语言模型的语法，同时显式建模了部分可观测性、随机性和信念。基于这一表述，我们提出了一种基于演示的流水线来学习PO-PDDL模型。所提出的方法从真实机器人执行视频中重建潜在的符号状态轨迹，通过推断状态与视觉观察之间的不一致性来识别部分可观测性，并相应地学习随机转移和观测模型。由此产生的PO-PDDL领域可跨任务复用，并能实现...
tldr: 本文提出PO-PDDL，一种符号化POMDP表述，结合PDDL语法并显式建模不确定性，通过从视觉演示中学习模型，使机器人能够在部分可观测和随机环境下进行规划。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PO-PDDL, a symbolic POMDP formulation combining PDDL syntax with explicit modeling of partial observability and stochasticity, enabling robot planning under uncertainty by learning models from visual demonstrations.
